ov: رحلة إلى مركز الأرض (الإنجليزية: Journey to the Center of the Earth) هو فلم مغامرة أُنتج في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 2008. من بطولة برندان فريزر وجوش هوتشرسن وأنيتا برايم.
plotEn:
In 2007, Trevor Anderson is a Bostonian volcanologist whose brother, Max, had disappeared ten years prior. Trevor learns at work that his brother's lab is being shut down because of a lack of funding. Elizabeth, Trevor's sister-in-law, drops off Sean, his 13-year-old nephew, at Trevor's house to spend ten days with him. 
When Elizabeth drops him off, she leaves Trevor with a box of items that belonged to Max. Sean suddenly takes interest in what Trevor has to say after he tells him about his father, whom he never really had a chance to know.
In the box, Trevor discovers the novel Journey to the Center of the Earth by Jules Verne. Inside the book, Trevor finds notes written by Max, and realising the notes contain historical data from his seismometers, he brings Sean to his laboratory to check its current readings. After noticing that the readings match those of Max's notes, and that a previously dead seismometer in Iceland has started to transmit again, he decides to go to Iceland to investigate for himself.
Trevor intends to send Sean back to his mother, but relents at the latter's protests, so he brings Sean to Iceland with him. They start by looking for another volcanologist; Sigurbjörn Asgeirsson. When they arrive at Asgeirsson's institution, they meet his daughter Hannah, who informs them he died. She also tells them that both her father and Max believed that Jules Verne's books were factual accounts.
